delta.comment: Created by operator-directed contract replanning (2026-08-19) to carry the P-021 C2/C3 semantic regression suite. Rationale: all three prior fix-cycle defects lived on carriers where the clause was PRESENT and byte-identical to its dogfood, so byte-identity and clause-presence tests would both have passed while the contract was self-contradictory. Each prior defect plus the dangling-reconciliation obligation maps to a named failing test, and a NO-PR/NO-THREAD-ASSUMPTION guard targets the shared root cause directly. Depends on 134.011-T (single edge; 011 already transitively orders after all content tasks and establishes the render-helper pattern). Separate test file, so no contention with 011.

Readiness fix cycle 1 (review of 1dad725a): added CARRIER-SET RESOLUTION rule (carrier sets now resolve from the authoritative matrix in 134.011-T; this task must not restate it), C3-SYMMETRIC-GUARD test (H12 scope-contraction guard on both workflow-policies and circuit-breaker, a carrier the matrix previously omitted entirely), and C5-EXCEPTION test providing the policy-to-role-boundary contract coverage that makes the manifest-derived post-merge cleanup exception non-regressable, including a negative guard against an unqualified "or remove" prohibition.
